Juniper & Rye is a fictional sample, so its $48 per-person price and Vegetarian and Gluten-free labels are illustrative only. Still, it lines up nicely with your Italian and seasonal tastes, and the $48 sits under your $65 minimum budget, which is a handy way to see how a comparison would look.

One useful next step: use the app's save-plan control to keep this sample as a draft dinner plan. A saved plan is just a record, not a reservation, and nothing gets booked or sent. If you later look at real restaurants, refresh discovery so you're working from current candidates, and confirm any dietary needs and actual costs directly with the restaurant.
